title: AAPS continuously attempts to connect when disconnected from Dash Pods
body:
AAPS 3.4.0.0

After disconnecting from a Dash pod, AAPS will continuously state that it is trying to connect despite new Pod activation not being started.  This is usually not noticed when immediately starting a new pod.  While trying to connect, AAPS drains battery at a high rate.

This was observed on an AutoISF variant, which should not have any changes to Dash code.

Attached log was during a period of not having a pod active.  

[AndroidAPS._2026-02-09_09.log](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25248249/AndroidAPS._2026-02-09_09.log)

comments.body: I see this same behaviour too on the normal AAPS 3.4.0.0 Master.
